cost_calibers.site: site (fees only, ZERO slippage) = the published v2 caliber
cost_calibers.realistic: realistic (fees + slippage) - NOT comparable with site

cost_model.site: cost_rt(mkt,'site',stop_exit) = fees only, ZERO slippage (us200 0.05%, jp200 0.10% round trip) = the caliber the published v2 numbers are measured at
cost_model.realistic: cost_rt(mkt,'realistic',stop_exit) = fees + SLIP_SIDE per side (us200 0.0003, jp200 0.0005) + STOP_EXTRA on a stop exit. NOT comparable with site

borrow_cost_model: borrow fee = annual rate * held_sessions / 252, charged on the short legs only; rates 0 / 10% / 30%

tamper_must_fail.detail: the gate must FAIL on the tampered copy and the repo's own artifact must be byte-identical before and after
